title: A standing check that the browser engine matches the native one
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: Seven recorded matches, about half a megabyte, now have to replay to exactly the same result in the native engine and in the website's WebAssembly build. They cover the placeholder bots, the largest possible seed, a double knockout, per-tank stats, the real Tank Arena rules and policies, a sniper that needs a clear sight line, and a four-tank match that runs out of time. A deliberately edited match fails loudly, and headless Chrome agrees with Node.
next: the check goes into CI, from a spec for the workflow owner.
